constant_337_note: 48+49+39+54+56+52+39 = 337 in every horoscope; only the distribution across signs varies
lagna_note: Lagna is the eighth contributor in these tables (included in the canonical totals); some schools exclude it — variant disclosed

reading_lore.sav_strong: Sarvashtakavarga above 30 in a sign: strong; classical transit-reading use
reading_lore.sav_weak: Sarvashtakavarga below 28 in a sign: weak; classical transit-reading use

source: Benefic-place tables per B.V. Raman, Ashtakavarga System of Prediction, as tabulated in the modern VedAstro redaction (verified: row totals match the canonical constants; worked example of Raman's Standard Horoscope reproduced)

reductions.trikona: In each trikona triad (Aries-Leo-Sagittarius etc.), subtract the triad minimum from all three signs
reductions.ekadhipatya: For each same-lord pair with bindus in both signs and no planet occupying either, subtract the smaller from the larger
reductions.note: Ekadhipatya skipped when a planet occupies either sign of the pair (classical exception)
